description: Source code for TCPServerSocket class implementation, managing TCP server socket operations including listening, accepting connections, and socket management within the net namespace.

classes.name: TCPServerSocket
classes.description: Implements a TCP server socket with methods for listening, accepting connections, and managing socket lifecycle within the net namespace.

methods.name: AdoptSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing socket descriptor into the TCPServerSocket.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Configures the socket to listen on a specified address with optional IPv6-only mode.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection requests, with overload supporting peer address retrieval.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches socket operations from the current thread.

methods.name: ConvertAcceptedSocket
methods.description: Converts an accepted socket into a TCPClientSocket and outputs the accepted address.

methods.name: OnAcceptCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of an accept operation, processes the accepted socket.
